statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic events
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
This monitoring is medically necessary to clinically assess the recurrent symptoms and their possible cardiac origin
